Distribution and bionomy. Russian Far East (Primorye and South Khabarovsk Terr., Amur reg.), Korea, Northwest, Central and Southwest China (Provs Shaanxi, Hubei, Sichuan, Yunnan). The species occurs in broadleaved forests with oak. Moths fly in end of April, May and early June, syntopically and synchronously with preceding species. Larvae feed on Quercus mongolica, Q. dentata (Fagaceae) and probably on other oak species.
